You may accept, reject or remain uncertain and may abstain from a final numeric answer. Return exactly one JSON object, no markdown, with decision (accept/reject/uncertain), confidence (integer 0..100 in correctness of the candidate), answer (finite numeric answer to the full-table query, or null), and reason (a brief string). No other fields.
The attached sample-based check is computed from exactly these visible rows using the query's filtered mean and 2,000 bootstrap resamples. It supplies a percentile interval and a candidate flag. A flag suggests incompatibility with that sample-based check; no flag does not certify correctness. It supplies no population answer. Make your own final audit decision.
